snapshot.semantics: Deterministic digest of listed tracked package manifests and selected tracked JS/TS source files that exist in the current working tree, plus separate deletion-state markers and sorted lists for selected tracked source paths and immediate tracked package manifests absent from the filesystem. Missing paths are excluded because they are absent, not because they are untracked. A package with a missing manifest is not source-scanned or included in the current package set. This identifies inputs; it does not prove import resolution or runtime use.

method.scope: Tracked immediate packages/* and apps/* package.json paths enumerated from Git paths independently of filesystem traversal; present manifests define current package records, while missing tracked manifests are recorded and their package source paths are not scanned. Selected tracked JS/TS source paths under present package directories are scanned when present, and missing tracked source paths are recorded separately. Direct dependency keys in dependencies, devDependencies, optionalDependencies, and peerDependencies.
method.limitation: Consumer references are lexical @repo package-name occurrences and dependency keys. This is not AST resolution: comments, strings, excluded or untracked files, aliases, dynamic resolution, and runtime usage can cause false positives or omissions.
method.exports: Export keys are copied from package.json exports; their targets and runtime condition resolution are not validated.
